# ContingameIMESuper 由于官方版本（26.1）已内置输入法，本项目将永久停止维护。 [ContingameIME](https://github.com/ThinkingStudios/ContingameIME) 的非官方延续版。在全屏 Minecraft 中使用输入法。
# 预览 ### 窗口模式 ![window-input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldierRMB/ContingameIMESuper/refs/heads/1.21.x/dev/old/docs/WindowInput.gif) ### 全屏模式 ![fullscreen-input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoldierRMB/ContingameIMESuper/refs/heads/1.21.x/dev/old/docs/FullScreenInput.gif) # 切换键 - 单击切换键可在**临时输入状态**和**关闭状态**之间切换 - 双击切换键可切换到**开启模式** - 当鼠标移动且已有内容已确认上屏时，**临时输入状态**将切换为**关闭状态** ## 依赖项 - Fabric - [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-language-kotlin) - [Cloth Config API (Fabric)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cloth-config) - [Architectury API (Fabric)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/architectury-api) ### 运行此模组需要 VCRuntime141，请前往微软官方网站下载 [下载地址](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-US/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist) # 本模组代码参考/使用 - [ThinkingStudios/ContingameIME](https://github.com/ThinkingStudios/ContingameIME) (LGPL-2.1) - [Windmill-City/IngameIME-Minecraft](https://github.com/Windmill-City/IngameIME-Minecraft) (LGPL-2.1) - [Wybxc/IngameIME-Minecraft](https://github.com/Wybxc/IngameIME-Minecraft) (LGPL-2.1)
